preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 100000.
The length of string a is between 1 and 100000.

preconditions.expression: a consists of only the characters 'A', 'N', 'O', and 'T'
preconditions.description: String a contains only the characters 'A', 'N', 'O', and 'T'.

preconditions.expression: The sum of |a| over all test cases does not exceed 100000
preconditions.description: The total length of all strings a across all test cases does not exceed 100000.

postconditions.expression: b is a permutation of a
postconditions.description: The output string b is a rearrangement of the characters in the input string a.

postconditions.expression: The time for Anton's body to revert the DNA is maximized
postconditions.description: The output string b should be chosen such that the minimum number of swaps required to transform b back to a is maximized.
